cells.gaps: No regulation or decree made under the Act since October 2023, and no rule that others must check identity against the register, is on record.
cells.note: The National Registration (Amendment) Act 2025, assented on 23 March 2025 and described by the minister in 2026 as in effect (BWA-008, BWA-005), has the registrar assign an identity number to each person in the Unified Population Register (BWA-009), so question 3 is yes. No rule made under it is held, so not 5.
